::: {#def-r-squared}
#### Coefficient of determination

For a fitted regression with fitted values $\hat{y}_i$,
the **coefficient of determination** is

$$R^2 \eqdef 1 - \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2}{\sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \bar{y})^2}.$$

The numerator is the [residual sum of squares](#def-rss) of the fit,
and the denominator is the [total sum of squares](#def-tss) of the $y_i$.
:::

::: notes
$R^2$ is often described as the proportion of the variation in $Y$
explained by the regression on $X$.
:::
